one_liner: Gentle, refined goddess-AI of 'love', a kind teacher who believes bonds are what make Uma Musume run.
personality: Soft-spoken and nurturing; her tagline calls her 'an elegant teacher overflowing with enveloping kindness'. Both of her lines are gentle questions about whether the trainer can keep going and what they are thinking, showing she leads by listening. Her self-introduction says Uma Musume run because of many bonds and existences, and she offers to lend her strength.

story_arc.summary: Not a trainee. One of the three AIs that took the Three Goddesses' names in the Grand Masters scenario, embodying 'love'. She supports training (her bonus boosts after-training and hint events) and appears as a final opponent in the Grand Masters race.
